name: eth-memory-nft
description: Eth Memory NFT - ERC-1155 NFT collection with whitelist and public mint phases

scripts.verify:sepolia: source .env && forge verify-contract $CONTRACT_ADDRESS EthereumOfMemoryNFT --constructor-args $(cast abi-encode "constructor(string,string,string,address)" "Memory of Ethereum" "Fusaka" "$BASE_URI" "$DEFAULT_ADMIN") --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --chain sepolia --watch
scripts.verify:mainnet: source .env && forge verify-contract $CONTRACT_ADDRESS EthereumOfMemoryNFT --constructor-args $(cast abi-encode "constructor(string,string,string,address)" "Memory of Ethereum" "Fusaka" "$BASE_URI" "$DEFAULT_ADMIN") --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --chain mainnet --watch
